g.text: I have this idea for a mural
You and me are in the town square with bits of Techrot all over the place, fighting side by side, giving each other a look that’s a bit more than just comradely affection.
You and me are in ancient Höllvania, in the time of gods and monsters
Then up on a nearby roof is the God of Love, training his arrow on us both…
We are facing off against an army of skeletons in rotting armour, while up above us sits the God of Thunder, scowling and judgemental
IT’S QUINCY IN LITTLE PINK SHORTS
ROLLING DICE TO DECIDE OUR FATE
That image will never leave my mind now. Thanks!
That image will never leave my mind now. Thanks!
I’ve been trying to find the moment, you know. I can’t.
I’ve been trying to find the moment, you know. I can’t.
The moment when I realized I was in love with you, of course.
I remember thinking ‘well, this is bloody inconvenient, Eleanor, now you’re bound to make a complete fool of yourself.’
The moment when I realized that my life had been changed by you. When you had wriggled your way into my heart and become family.
But not when, or what we were doing.
I suppose I should say thank you. For listening to me. For entertaining all these wild fancies of mine. And, most importantly, for being my friend.
I... oh. I'm not ready for that kind of commitment... I'm sorry.
It doesn’t matter. I love you.
My Drifter. You fell into my life and turned everything on its head. Of all the choices you could have made, you chose me. You left me wide-eyed and wonderstruck.
What's the bloody point? I ask you. What is the bloody POINT??
Can I interest you in some enthusiastic kissing, with an option to proceed to rampant sexual intercourse?
Let’s start with kissing and see where we end up.
Let’s take it slow. Kissing is plenty.
Mmm. Let's feel our way forward, then. Sounds perfect.
And right there is the secret to making this work. Communication. If kissing is what you want, then kissing you shall have.
Yours in eager anticipation, E. xxx
